note: Everything exact is built before the cards are rented: rows, graphs, encoder vectors, both designs' first stages on scores from fits that did not see the example, frozen shortlists, the first-stage arms and the floor of baselines; the leak tests run on stored rows before any card hour. On the cards three queues that never wait for each other: each design trained whole on its own card, the third card for the ladder rungs on a quarter of the data, a bridge arm that puts the first design's propagation on the second design's first stage, one double removal; every slot has a hard end and a fixed order in which arms are dropped; a prediction per arm on a segment named before the run. Every veto read: nearest W9, W12 and W13, none met. Lacks, in words. The second design's trees are fitted on a sample sized to the PC's memory, about a twelfth of the rows that design asks for, which shrinks a learner to the PC against the owner's standing word. Disk for rows and vectors on the PC is not counted. Each design makes at most one pass, on one fixed sample of negatives; the first design loses its joint loss over both stages; the rungs use an untuned joint reading, so a rung may not speak for its top. M7 open on its nine counts.

One joint reader trained once against the fixed baseline offset and cached; above it seven arms: the baselines, a linear and a tree first stage on the same columns, and the four pairings with a reader head or a typed propagation; neighbours differ in one decision at full data; trees are fitted on all their rows in the first card hour; 24 card-hours accounted, with a rule for when a propagation pass runs long. Every veto read: nearest W9 and W12, none met. Lacks, in words. Neither design left standing is trained as it stands: the reader is no longer trained on what the earlier stages misrank nor through the first design's propagation, so the comparison is of two decisions above a shared reader and not of the two designs. The heads read the reader's vectors on the very rows the reader was trained on, where both designs had every stage read scores from fits that did not see the example (D 6.4); only early stopping stands against it. The propagation gets about one pass. M7 open on its counts.
